# PDF.js 6.4.299

Mozilla PDF.js generic-legacy build, Apache-2.0. Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases/tag/v6.4.299
Official package: https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-6.4.299.tgz
Package integrity (SHA512): sha512-AVl138zALtfaAPvADulE0PZThbYzCBS79nL4pOSL/6Sm/4AH5A21BD9VHt97OlCuzJuCpmeZtAtkinisF4Vb1g==

The official legacy/build/pdf.min.mjs and legacy/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs provide browser compatibility polyfills in both execution contexts. Only the minified API and worker are retained as gzip assets. No package configuration or npm install scripts are used. Files are served from the application origin and extracted in browser workers.
